description: RETRY (2026-09-26, connection 2 of this investigation). Connection 1 (real, work/verify/results/harness-selftest-2026-09-26T11-57-52-819Z.json) found that BOTH heredoc-written files (T0ZERO and the CL wrapper source itself) failed CPYFRMSTMF identically: CPC7305 (member added) then CPC7309 (member removed) then CPFA0A2 (information passed to this operation was not valid) then CPFA095 (stream file not copied). advisor's diagnosis, confirmed against docs/probes.md:140/152 (CPFA095 alone means 'not found', but the CPFA0A2 preceding it here means a CONVERSION failure, not a missing-file failure - a materially different signature): qsh converts the SSH-piped script's bytes into the job's own (EBCDIC) CCSID before `cat` ever sees them, so `cat > file <<'DELIM'` writes EBCDIC bytes; `setccsid 1208` then only RETAGS the file's CCSID attribute to 1208 (ASCII/UTF-8) WITHOUT converting the underlying bytes, so CPYFRMSTMF - trusting that tag (or the explicit STMFCCSID(1208) override) - tries to decode EBCDIC bytes as if they were already 1208 and fails. This connection tests the `ccsid: false` candidate (skip setccsid AND STMFCCSID entirely, both on this file step and on the wrapper source itself via the new top-level wrapperCcsid:false, letting CPYFRMSTMF fall back to its own undocumented-in-this-repo's-refs default) and adds debugCcsid diagnostics (ls -S / attr -p CCSID / od -x, both immediately after the heredoc write and - since ccsid is false here, skipping setccsid - only once) so that even if this candidate ALSO fails, the actual on-disk CCSID tag and byte pattern (2020=ASCII vs 4040=EBCDIC for RPG's leading spaces) settle the question for the next attempt rather than guessing again. Also echoes $HOME at the very start (ruled out as the cause already, since result.stderr showed no mkdir/cat/setccsid errors last time, but kept as a one-line sanity check).

steps.note: 自分のライブラリー(&LIB=<USER>2)の全オブジェクト一覧(件数を絞らない。2026-09-26、advisor指摘: <USER>2はサンプルDB・TXツール・第4部の成果物で既に30件を超えている可能性が高く、ORDER BY OBJCREATED DESC + FETCH FIRST 30だと肝心の古いオブジェクト(9/24のTXツール等、第6部0509・07-05の前提確認に必要)が切り捨てられてしまう)。db2 呼び出し自体が動くかどうかと、この接続でT0ZEROが実際に作られたかどうかの両方を確かめる。他人のライブラリーは走査しない。
steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB','*ALL')) X ORDER BY OBJNAME
